description.narrative: INDEPTH network (International Network for the Demographic Evaluation of Populations & Their Health) ett internationellt nätverk m 43 demografiska forskningsstationer för befolkningsstudier i 20 låg- och medelinkomstländer. Genom dessa forskningsstationer följs sammanlagt 3,2 miljoner människor, vilket ger unik information om befolkningstrender i dessa länder.

Support to the International Network for the Demographic Evaluation of Populations and their Health (INDEPTH, an Africa, asian and Latin American network of demographic suites to provide better, empirical understanding of health and social issues and to apply this understanding to alleviate severe health and social changes.

There is no current support to INDEPTH. The contribution is to be closed once the audited report for year 2017 is submitted and repayment of costs for which the KPMG audit did not find sufficient documentation is settled. USD 200 000 has been repaid in 2023 and USD 100 000 is yet to be repaid.
